rationale: All six devices were offline simultaneously while the base station showed online=false and uplink=no_internet, pointing to a system-level network fault rather than a peripheral issue. The customer had switched to a new ISP/router on Monday, and the base station's Ethernet cable was in the wrong port. After moving the cable to a LAN port and power-cycling the router and base station, the LED turned solid blue and all devices (including the garden camera) came back online — confirming the root cause and resolving the complaint without any battery replacement.

repair_steps: Confirm the base station LED is solid blue and all devices show online in the app.
Advise the customer to keep the Ethernet cable in a LAN port on the new router.
Document the root cause as BS_NETWORK_DOWN (L1) and close the case.
